sources.note: EMBO's own programme page for Postdoctoral Fellowships (embo.org, awarding body's domain)
EMBO Postdoctoral Fellowships eligibility criteria sub-page

awarding_body.detail: The page is on embo.org, the European Molecular Biology Organization's own domain, under Funding > Fellowships, grants and career support > Postdoctoral Fellowships, and describes the scheme as EMBO's own.
awarding_body.quote: EMBO Postdoctoral Fellowships support excellent postdoctoral researchers throughout Europe and the world for a period of up to two years.

deadline.detail: The page states applications are accepted throughout the year with the next hard cutoff date Friday 22 January 2027, 14:00 CET, exactly matching the record. That cutoff is in the future as of 12 October 2026, so the cycle is currently open.
deadline.quote: Applications accepted throughout the year (next cutoff date – hard deadline: Friday 22 January 2027, 14:00 CET)

eligibility.detail: All distinct claims in the record are confirmed on the eligibility page: doctorate required, PhD obtained within the two years prior to application, at least one first-author publication (or a first-author preprint with verifiably obtained public in-depth peer reviews), and compulsory movement between countries that excludes returning to the PhD country. The record's 'life sciences' framing is consistent with EMBO's remit ('Excellence in life sciences' on the page).
eligibility.quote: Applicants who already hold a PhD at the time of application are eligible to apply only if they obtained it during the two years prior to the date the application is submitted. Applicants must have at least one first author publication (research paper) accepted in or published in an international peer reviewed journal at the time of application. ... All applications must involve movement between countries ... Applications to go to the country in which the PhD was obtained will not be considered.

funding.detail: Funding is a salary or stipend plus relocation/travel allowance and child support: in EMBC Member States EMBO grants the host institution funds to issue an employment contract; fellows elsewhere receive a stipend. This matches the record's 'Stipend and Salary'. Note the award explicitly does not cover bench fees, overheads or consumables.
funding.quote: EMBO provides grants for host institutions in EMBC Member States to issue employment contracts to EMBO Fellows. Fellows working in other countries than EMBC Member States will receive a stipend.

degree_levels.detail: The scheme is exclusively postdoctoral: applicants must hold a doctorate at the start of the fellowship, and fellowships last up to two years (minimum one year). Matches the record's 'Postdoctoral'.
degree_levels.quote: EMBO Postdoctoral Fellowships are awarded for a period of two years although shorter durations can be requested. The minimum fellowship duration that can be requested is one year.

recommended_field_updates.deadline_text: Applications accepted throughout the year (next cutoff date – hard deadline: Friday 22 January 2027, 14:00 CET)
recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Verified live on 12 October 2026 against EMBO's own pages; the 22 January 2027, 14:00 CET cutoff is the currently open cycle. Two rule changes now posted on the eligibility page that a future re-check should track: (1) from the Autumn 2027 selection round (applications submitted after January 22, 2027, 14:00 CET) re-applications will no longer be permitted; (2) from the Autumn 2026 round a host laboratory may support a maximum of one candidate per selection round. Funding model splits by host location: employment-contract grant in EMBC Member States vs stipend elsewhere; bench fees/overheads are not covered.
